note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for SC-300, 'Skills measured as of April 27, 2026'. Weights are taken from the study guide's 'Skills at a glance' summary; note that Microsoft's own page prints 20-25% on the detailed heading for 'Implement authentication and access management' while the summary lists 25-30%, and the summary is used here. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Implement and manage user identities
subtopics: Configure and manage built-in and custom Microsoft Entra roles
Recommend, configure, and manage administrative units
Evaluate effective permissions for Microsoft Entra roles
Configure domains, company branding, and tenant, user, group, and device settings
Create, configure, and manage users, groups, and custom security attributes
Automate bulk operations with the admin center and PowerShell, and report on licences
Manage external collaboration, cross-tenant access, and cross-tenant synchronisation
Implement hybrid identity with Entra Connect Sync, Cloud Sync, PHS, PTA, and seamless SSO

domains.name: Implement authentication and access management
subtopics: Plan for authentication and manage methods, including certificate-based auth, Temporary Access Pass, and passkeys (FIDO2)
Implement tenant-wide multifactor authentication settings and self-service password reset
Implement Windows Hello for Business and Microsoft Entra password protection
Disable accounts, revoke user sessions, and enable Entra Kerberos for hybrid identities
Plan Conditional Access policies, assignments, and controls
Implement session management, device-enforced restrictions, and continuous access evaluation
Configure authentication context and protected actions
Manage user risk and sign-in risk with Microsoft Entra ID Protection
Deploy Global Secure Access clients, Private Access, and Internet Access

domains.name: Plan and implement workload identities
subtopics: Select appropriate identities for applications and Azure workloads
Create managed identities and assign them to Azure resources
Plan and implement settings for enterprise applications at application and tenant level
Integrate on-premises apps with Microsoft Entra Application Proxy
Design and implement integration for SaaS applications
Assign, classify, and manage users, groups, and app roles for enterprise applications
Configure and manage user and admin consent
Plan and create app registrations, app authentication, API permissions, and app roles
Manage and monitor app access with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps

domains.name: Plan and automate identity governance
subtopics: Plan entitlements and create and configure catalogs and access packages
Manage access requests, terms of use, and the lifecycle of external users
Configure and manage connected organisations
Plan, create, and configure access reviews and respond to review activity
Plan and manage Microsoft Entra roles and Azure resources in Privileged Identity Management
Configure PIM for Groups and manage the request and approval process
Analyse PIM audit history and create and manage break-glass accounts
Review sign-in, audit, and provisioning logs and configure diagnostic settings
Monitor Microsoft Entra ID with KQL queries, workbooks, and Identity Secure Score
